$meta.name: RealGram Design Tokens
$meta.description: Single source of truth for RealGram + Shahnameh visual identity. Consume these in CSS variables, Tailwind config, or a theme file.
$meta.note: Gold = owned / connected / earned. Silver = locked / disconnected / not-yet-converted. This state pair is the core brand mechanic and applies to the coin mark everywhere.

green.role: success / connected-status / REAL positive / VPN active

red.role: disconnect warning / spend / rival / mythic rarity

gradient.appBg: radial-gradient(70% 40% at 50% 30%, rgba(255,138,61,0.10), transparent 65%), radial-gradient(60% 30% at 80% 0%, rgba(123,92,250,0.14), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(50% 25% at 10% 4%, rgba(51,211,255,0.08), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, #090C15 0%, #05060A 40%, #030308 100%)

motion.principle: Motion is ambient and calm, never busy. Nothing loops fast. Gen-Z polish = smooth reveals + one hero motion per screen, not many competing animations.

state_mechanic.hold_3s: Holding the coin 3s toggles VPN connection; a red ring fills over 3000ms. Tap = forge Zar.
state_mechanic.ad_policy: AdMob banners live between content sections (never mid-tap, never mid-conversation). Adsgram/AdMob rewarded = Watch & Earn (+REAL) and Refill-via-ad. Rewarded ads are framed as economy actions, not interruptions.
